name: typst-math
description: Typst Math syntax plugin for Obsidian

scripts.build:wasm: cd ../../crates/typst-math-wasm && wasm-pack build --target web --release && sed -i "s/new URL('typst_math_wasm_bg.wasm', import.meta.url)/'typst_math_wasm_bg.wasm'/g" pkg/typst_math_wasm.js
scripts.build:wasm:dev: cd ../../crates/typst-math-wasm && wasm-pack build --target web --dev && sed -i "s/new URL('typst_math_wasm_bg.wasm', import.meta.url)/'typst_math_wasm_bg.wasm'/g" pkg/typst_math_wasm.js
